description: Traffic accidents situation April 2018 (series on data.go.jp) is a series of datasets listed in Data Catalog Site of the Japanese government (data.go.jp), an open data portal, published or maintained by 警察庁. Coverage: Japan. The portal lists 9 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 警察庁. Its tags are 交通事故統計, 統計, 統計調査結果. It offers 1 resource(s) in xls. The portal shows 2023-05-23 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-datago-portal.
